name: Long-term environmental specimen banking of cryo-homogenised sub-samples in the vapour phase above liquid nitrogen (below -150 C)
plain_name: Archive environmental samples for decades above liquid nitrogen
description: Environmental specimens (fish, mussels, bird eggs, plants, soils, human blood and urine) are deep-frozen in the gas phase above liquid nitrogen, ground while frozen, divided into about 10 g sub-samples and archived long-term above liquid nitrogen below -150 C so that future analysts can measure pollutants retrospectively (German ESB, NIST Biorepository).
keywords: Archive environmental samples for decades above liquid nitrogen

sources.citation: Specimen archive - German Environmental Specimen Bank (Umweltprobenbank des Bundes)
The NIST Biorepository (Marine Environmental Specimen Bank), National Institute of Standards and Technology

reported_equipment: cryo tank (gaseous phase above liquid nitrogen)

requirements.rationale: Sub-specimens are stored below -150 C (123.15 K).
The archive keeps specimens in the vapour above liquid nitrogen.
Each archived sub-specimen portion is about 10 g.
